gap_text: The mcporter retained_operation_ids (fresh-static-graph, fresh-static-callees, fresh-memory-status, fresh-socraticode-status) appear only as IDs in saturation-audit.json. No public receipt I read defines their commands or results.
next_check: Run fresh-static-graph, fresh-static-callees, fresh-memory-status and fresh-socraticode-status as explicit `mcporter call` commands, and publish a receipt defining each command, its exit status and its output.

preregistration.expectation: The four retained operation ids are defined in the host-local combined-functional-summary.json (argv, cwd, checks). Re-run as explicit `mcporter call` commands against isolated servers they exit 0: search_graph returns the `collect` node, trace_path returns outbound callees, memory_status returns a structured counts object, codebase_status returns structured status text.
preregistration.criteria: settled if each of the four ids is published with its command definition, a fresh exit status and its output, and each passes the retained check; advanced if a definition or run is missing; not_settled if a run fails.

addenda.label: added arm, written after the isolated-fixture runs and before this arm ran
addenda.expectation: Inside the namespace, before the owned services start, connecting to 49374/16333 is refused (probe that would detect live contact). Then: installed mcporter 0.13.13 with the unmodified $HOME/codex-ecosystem/config/mcporter.json lists context-mode, ai-memory and socraticode and runs ctx_execute_file (agent-lab README.md), memory_status (0 counts = owned store) and codebase_status; the retained ad-hoc jcodemunch --stdio call and the Inspector context-mode arithmetic call (42) pass. Inspector with agent-lab's unmodified .mcp.json lists tools for serena, ai-memory and socraticode from inside the project, calls memory_status and codebase_status, fails without --config (no cwd auto-discovery), fails with a relative --config from outside, and with an absolute --config from outside runs codebase_status against the OUTSIDE cwd (the .mcp.json socraticode entry sets no cwd).
addenda.criteria: Gap 0: settled only if every retained call passes on the unmodified host config and binaries (context-mode start.mjs from the read-only plugin cache may fail; that is reported, not hidden). Gap 8 remains advanced (no Desktop/plugin/hooks).

addenda.label: FIX ROUND 1, written after the round-1 independent review (raw/review-codex-round1.txt, received 04:35:13Z) and before the fix-round runs
addenda.expectation: Re-running the bridge matrix, both lifecycle fixtures and the unmodified-config arm inside unshare -rnm with an empty tmpfs mounted over $HOME/.mcporter (the shared daemon's socket path does not exist there) gives the same outcomes. A connect probe to the shared socket path inside the namespace returns ENOENT, while the same probe against the owned daemon socket connects. That owned control shows the probe detects a reachable socket. wong2 interactive listing is executed x3 for all 5 servers and renders at most one page (10 tools). With a lock holder that EXITS ON ITS OWN (sleep with a fixed lifetime, no harness kill), a call made while the lock is held times out after 45 s, a second call while still held also fails, and the first call after the holder exits succeeds with no step taken by the harness or the operator.
addenda.criteria: Gap 10 and the no-contact claim in the other receipts are settled only by the enforced (tmpfs + netns) runs with the probe and owned control recorded. Gap 12/6: settled only if every wong2 list arm executed (interactive), with incompleteness reported as a result. Gap 9: the startup-timeout conclusion is restated to match what the natural-expiry arm shows.

addenda.label: FIX ROUND 3, written after the round-4 independent Opus review (raw/review-opus-round4.json) and before the chrishayuk/mcp-cli clone and review
addenda.expectation: chrishayuk/mcp-cli (a Python CLI chat/command client) spawns stdio servers per invocation and has no persistent bridge daemon, so it has no daemon-recovery role and is rejected for the gap-7 concrete gap. Source citations at a pinned commit will show how it launches servers and whether any persistent/reconnect state exists.
addenda.criteria: Gap 7 stays settled only if chrishayuk/mcp-cli is reviewed at a pinned commit with verbatim citations and a disposition, and the receipt's disposition arm lists every section-rule entry (wong2 included with its role). If its source shows a persistent daemon with automatic stale-state recovery, it becomes keep-but-compare instead. Gaps 1, 3, 5: presentation/sanitization fixes only; outcomes unchanged unless the regenerated receipts contradict them. A committed verify_receipts.py recomputes sha256 of each g2-units.json gap text and checks it, the required receipt fields, and results.json equality.

Fix round 1 runs are ENFORCED: unshare -rnm with an empty tmpfs over $HOME/.mcporter and a fresh network namespace (enforce.py / ns_exact.py).
